//: Online co-op lobby. MULTIPLAYER goes to the pilot select like START; once a pilot is chosen this page opens instead of mission select, and mission select follows as soon as both players are connected. HOST GAME listens and shows on the line under the status where it is listed or this PC's address (the NET address when the router opened the port, else the LAN one). The address row takes a friend's address or a relay server's (A on it to edit: type it, or left/right pick a number and up/down change it; A or B to finish). JOIN GAME opens the JOIN GAME page: it lists the open games of this build from Steam and the saved relay server, and tries the typed address, which becomes the saved server if a relay server answers and is joined as a host otherwise. Picking a listed game joins it, and a locked one turns its row into an empty password prompt (type six digits, then A, B or Enter joins). The page's status line is a note (small white text, not an entry). HOST SETTINGS sets the name the list shows and an optional password (an emptied password field is none). When a host asks for a password, the address row becomes the password until the next JOIN GAME: six digits typed there join that host again, and an emptied field is none. Rows with label_src follow live text from the game (docs/guides/adding-menus-and-buttons.md).
